catalysts.headline: VEEA closed at $4.30, down 10.8% from the previous close
Nasdaq notified Veea that its remaining listing-compliance matter (governance/minimum-bid-price deficiencies) had been resolved and closed

Veea resolved governance matters following an unexpected board vacancy (board/committee changes); shares rose 47.3% to $5.70; Nasdaq listing compliance restored after the post-split closing bid price held at/above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (Aug 31-Sept 14, 2026)

TROLLEE agreement signed for phased deployment of the VeeaONE platform to 1,000 unattended retail stores

Signed an agreement with TROLLEE Holdings for phased deployment of the VeeaONE platform across up to 1,000 unattended retail stores, beginning with up to 50 locations, extending a strategic partnership with TROLLEE originally dating to 2018.

catalysts.headline: Veea and NovaGen signed a non-binding term sheet for a ~$750M combination to form NovaGen Health Networks on VeeaONE; GeoNova Capital commits an initial $10M investment

Signed a non-binding term sheet for a business combination with NovaGen Group B.V. (regenerative medicine/longevity) to form 'NovaGen Health Networks'; implied combined valuation ~$750M (management estimate); GeoNova Capital signed a term sheet for a proposed $10M investment. Parties targeted execution of a definitive agreement 'within the coming weeks' -- STILL NOT EXECUTED as of the most recent information found in this session (no October 2026 definitive-agreement filing located)
